title: ExternalSecret sync failure after AWS Secrets Manager rotation
symptoms: Pods fail to start with CreateContainerConfigError
Application auth failures after scheduled secret rotation
ESO controller logs show AccessDenied or secret version mismatch
root_cause: ESO refresh interval longer than rotation frequency; IAM role missing secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on new version; app caches old credential
workaround: Force ESO refresh: kubectl annotate externalsecret <name> force-sync=$(date +%s); restart affected deployments
permanent_fix: Set ESO refreshInterval ≤ rotation period/2; use IRSA with least-privilege policy; implement app-side credential reload; add Datadog monitor on ExternalSecret sync status

auto_healing.mechanism: ESO automatic refresh + Reloader sidecar/inject triggers pod restart on secret change

notes: Audit all ExternalSecrets for refreshInterval vs Secrets Manager rotation schedule
